propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped, creating one PAT per test and consuming O(tests) tokens against Jira DC's 10-PAT-per-user cap, exhausting the budget and failing test setup
The PAT creation failure mis-attributes to unrelated test modules because it surfaces at whichever test happens to run after the budget is spent, making root cause diagnosis difficult
Leftover tokens from crashed harness runs persist and poison subsequent runs by consuming cap headroom before new tests execute
Session-scoped jira_dc_pat fixture with one PAT per run reduces consumption from O(tests) to O(1), eliminating the scaling failure as more live tests are added
A defensive token sweep at session start, using raw REST with empty-result degradation on enumeration failure, removes stale rebar-j5-harness-* tokens without aborting the session
